card.line: Fair Havens was a harbor on the southern coast of Crete, where Paul's ship stopped and Paul warned of danger before the voyage went on toward disaster.

moments.title: Arrival at Fair Havens
moments.text: After a hard trip along the coast of Crete, Paul and the others reached a place called Fair Havens, near the town of Lasea.

moments.title: Paul's warning
moments.text: Much time had passed and sailing had become dangerous. Paul warned that the trip would bring disaster and great loss to the ship, the cargo, and their lives.

moments.title: The decision to sail on
moments.text: The centurion listened to the pilot and the ship's owner instead of Paul. Since the harbor was not good for winter, most chose to sail on, and soon a fierce storm called the Northeaster struck.
